title: The Mabbot street entrance of nighttown,
html_source:
Mabbot Street is just north of the Liffey, and was renamed Commercial Street in the years after Ulysses. It’s now been somewhat bluntly renamed “James Joyce Street”, and can be seen on the Visit Dublin Ulysses Tour.

James Joyce Street, looking back towards the Liffey, via Google Street View.

“Nighttown” is the part of the town where prostitutes congregated– what we call the “red light district” today.
